direction: Evolve the L2a static pairwise merge hook toward a globally depot-distance-normalized generalized savings family — score(i,j) = (d0i + d0j - lam*d_ij + mu*|d0i - d0j|) / mean(d(0,1..n)) + beta*clip((q_i+q_j)/Q,0,1) + optional endpoint-demand-balance term — with lam in [1.00,1.15], mu in [0.08,0.15], beta in [0.05,0.15], so radial far-customer priority is preserved under global (never per-pair) scaling; then apply relocate_2opt to close the documented inter-route relocate gap and clean residual 2-opt crossings.

operations.mechanism: KB entry method-cvrp-m2-l2a-generalized-savings pins the exact evohook form, parameter ranges (lam 1.00-1.15, mu 0.08-0.15, beta 0.05-0.15), the hard invariant 'never divide by per-pair (d0i+d0j)', and measured dev_24 = 16.1398 with 'none' postprocess (vs bare CW 16.2225), giving a concrete, reproducible starting point for evolution rather than a blind guess. The evidence-cvrp-m2-perpair-scale-normalization-antipattern entry quantifies the failure mode we must avoid (dev_24 degrading to ~18.0). The L2a entry's own 'unconfirmed item' explicitly flags the non-trivial test of pairing the evolved merge start with relocate-style local search, and its weak_on list names 'no_post_merge_inter_route_relocate' as the unaddressed regime — so relocate_2opt is the evidence-backed marginal-gain lever for this round while the sub-4ms hook keeps large budget headroom (L2b entry shows tight-budget degradation only when the template itself refreshes candidates). Starting the archive from this strong, well-documented L2a anchor also seeds useful Pareto diversity for later L3 ruins.

preserve: Route feasibility, strict time budget, and scale invariance.
hypothesis: H1: Normalizing the generalized Clarke-Wright savings by a single global depot-distance scale mean(d(0,1..n)) (instead of the per-pair (d0i+d0j) normalization that destroys far-edge radial priority) plus a dimensionless capacity-fill bonus produces a merge hook that beats plain CW on dev_24 (<=16.16 mean tour length at 0 ms hook overhead). H2: Because L2a's known weakness is 'no_post_merge_inter_route_relocate', layering relocate_2opt on top of the evolved merge start yields strictly lower mean tour length than the identical hook with postprocess 'none', at negligible risk of exceeding the 500 ms budget (merge p95 ~10-12 ms at n=200).
